chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding seeking rain.
O Allah, have mercy upon us with abundance and productivity, and grant us wealth after poverty, and open for us from Your mercy, O Most Merciful.

key_terms.الْخَصْبِ: Abundance and fertility of the land

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali ask for in the Istisqa sermon?
ai.summary: This supplication, delivered during a time of drought, reflects the Shia understanding of Istisqa as both a spiritual act of worship and a practical invocation for socio-economic relief, emphasizing divine mercy over mere natural phenomena. It highlights the Imam’s role as an intercessor who connects communal hardship with theological concepts of sin, gratitude, and agricultural blessing, rooted in the Prophetic tradition of seeking rain through sincere repentance.
